items.stem: A customer admin wants live help from Glean Support in a small group. Where should they look?

options.text: Post a request on the product ideas board.
Events: the monthly troubleshooting session on the second Thursday.

items.stem: Why should a user register for Gleaniverse with a work email?

options.text: Because personal email addresses are shown publicly.
It is optional and has no effect.
So they receive the correct role and permissions.

items.stem: A customer reports an error in their own Glean instance. Where does it go?

options.text: A new forum thread with the error log.
Submit it as a product idea for voting.

items.stem: Where should a feature request go?

options.text: An email to a Glean contact.
The Feedback and Ideas board in Gleaniverse.

items.stem: Which post breaks the community guidelines?

options.text: A question that follows a search that found no existing thread.
A post that includes a user's email address and an internal document link.
A reply that shares what worked for another admin.
